challenge_signature_definition: ordered normal orders with quantity + time_limit_sec + VIP enabled/cocktail_level/quantity; score thresholds and rewards excluded

classification_definitions.ANALYTICAL_TIMER_RATIO_OUTLIER: absolute timer/cost ratio deviation from cohort median is greater than 5 percent
classification_definitions.HIGH_RISK_SOLVER_FAILURE: at least five canonical-scale audited trials for the exact class with zero completions
classification_definitions.MATHEMATICALLY_UNREACHABLE: mandatory target cannot be built from legal L1/L2/L3 spawn and equal-merge closure or record is structurally invalid
classification_definitions.SCREENING_FAILURE_NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: the single V04 broad-screen trial failed and fewer than five audited canonical-scale trials exist
classification_definitions.SOLVER_FEASIBLE: at least one canonical-scale qualified-solver trial for the class completed
classification_definitions.SPATIAL_MIX_OUTLIER_CANDIDATE: same normal cost/timer but materially different feasibility or danger signal; candidate only because samples are small
classification_definitions.VIP_INTERCEPTION_RISK: minimum forced VIP captures before mandatory completion is greater than zero

interpretation_boundary: One qualified-solver completion proves at least one solver-feasible path, not human difficulty.
One failed screening seed does not prove impossibility.
0/5 qualified-solver evidence is a high-risk candidate, not proof no human can complete.
Historical 4x results are excluded from decision classifications.
V04 authorizes no timer, objective, VIP, physics, or canonical data change.
